title: Chanjet end-to-end integration delivery queue

current_verified_baseline.field_catalog: 3341 observed / 0 blocking required fields after adapter contract

global_forbidden_actions: Chanjet write/update/delete before Wave 7 explicit approval
production migration or deploy without a separate Gate

tasks.title: Freeze program contract and current revision
tasks.objective: Freeze scope, enabled books, endpoint catalog revision, source-of-truth rules and hard boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Contract names every enabled book and current readonly scope

tasks.title: Refresh authenticated readonly and data-readiness evidence
tasks.objective: Capture fresh book, endpoint, row-count, freshness and five-difference evidence without changing provider or ERP business data.

tasks.title: Review token, callback, RBAC and DataScope boundaries
tasks.objective: Verify secret handling, read/write credential separation, callback signature, menu guard, audit and book/company DataScope.
acceptance_criteria: No secret appears in logs or reports

tasks.title: Run baseline CI and runtime gates
tasks.objective: Record API/Web typecheck, focused tests, W5, migration and current-state audit baseline.
acceptance_criteria: All baseline checks have explicit results
No missing evidence is reported as PASS

tasks.title: Lock AR open-balance semantics
tasks.objective: Define Chanjet counterparty-period AR authority and ERP invoice drill-down without inserting aggregate rows into fin_ar_invoices.

tasks.title: Lock AP open-balance semantics
tasks.objective: Define supplier-period AP authority and ERP payable/purchase drill-down with explicit status and period rules.

tasks.title: Lock cash and bank balance semantics
tasks.objective: Split cash balance by account book, company, mapped account, currency, original/base amount and balance date.
acceptance_criteria: No unmatched account or currency enters an authority total

tasks.title: Lock daily receipt document semantics
tasks.objective: Govern receipt identity, effective status, accounting/business date, reversal and amount rules across books.

tasks.title: Lock daily payment document semantics
tasks.objective: Govern payment identity, effective status, accounting/business date, reversal and amount rules across books.

tasks.title: Consolidate semantic contracts into one backend authority model
tasks.objective: Remove duplicated metric logic and publish one typed source/freshness/difference contract.

tasks.title: Security and CI exit Gate for finance semantics
tasks.objective: Review cross-book leakage, DataScope, audit and financial authority; hand off to A1 for static/runtime validation.
acceptance_criteria: A2 PASS or PASS WITH CONDITIONS with no P0 blocker
Five metrics have zero unexplained P0 differences

tasks.title: Discover the full authorized readonly endpoint catalog
tasks.objective: Compare enabled provider capabilities, local catalog and observed traffic; classify readable, unsupported and blocked endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Every discovered endpoint has a disposition
No guessed endpoint is marked ready

tasks.title: Complete master and reference readonly adapters
tasks.objective: Normalize books, subjects, counterparties, departments, projects, cash accounts, currencies, warehouses and products exposed by the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: All cataloged master scopes are normalized

tasks.title: Complete business document readonly adapters
tasks.objective: Normalize receivables, payables, receipts, payments, purchase/sales documents and stock movements exposed by the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Headers and lines retain provider identity

tasks.title: Complete voucher and statutory report readonly adapters
tasks.objective: Normalize voucher headers/lines, subject balance, balance sheet, income statement and cash flow with report-period parameters.

tasks.title: Harden pagination, envelopes, rate limits and raw evidence retention
tasks.objective: Use one adapter pipeline for transport success, business success, pagination, 429/5xx retry and raw/normalized traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Raw and normalized rows share job identity

tasks.title: Build endpoint and field drift detection
tasks.objective: Detect added, removed and type-changed fields and create actionable alerts without breaking stable adapters.

tasks.title: Readonly coverage exit Gate
tasks.objective: Verify 100% discovered catalog disposition, field coverage, tests, typecheck and authenticated smoke.
acceptance_criteria: Every discovered readonly endpoint is ready, unsupported or held with reason

tasks.title: Close book-company-currency identity
tasks.objective: Verify each enabled book maps to the correct ERP company and allowed currencies with no cross-book identity reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Each book has one approved company contract

tasks.title: Close customer and supplier identities
tasks.objective: Resolve role-specific counterparties, duplicate names/codes and source-only identities without conflating customer and supplier roles.

tasks.title: Close department, project and organization identities
tasks.objective: Separate readonly source references from approved ERP write targets and document missing ERP peers.
acceptance_criteria: Every referenced identity has exact/source-only/hold status
Source-only cannot be used for writeback

tasks.title: Close cash-account and subject identities
tasks.objective: Verify account-book-scoped cash account, currency, subject and expense-type mapping needed by cards and future vouchers.
acceptance_criteria: P0 cash accounts map exactly or remain held

tasks.title: Implement mapping governance and audit workflow
tasks.objective: Enforce exact/source-only/needs-review/conflict states, immutable history, reversal and write-target eligibility.

tasks.title: Master identity security and readiness Gate
tasks.objective: Verify mapping permissions, audit integrity, DataScope and future write-target safety; run A1 validation.
acceptance_criteria: Required conflicts and ambiguous mappings are zero

tasks.title: Publish governed finance read-model APIs
tasks.objective: Expose authority, fallback, difference, freshness and drill-down contracts for cards, ledgers, statements and vouchers.
acceptance_criteria: Every metric declares source and freshness

tasks.title: Align ordinary finance cards with Chanjet authority
tasks.objective: Render AR, AP, cash, receipt and payment values with source, freshness, fallback and difference states.

tasks.title: Deliver statements, voucher and balance read views
tasks.objective: Provide subject balance, balance sheet, income statement, cash flow and voucher drill-down without fabricating ERP peers.

tasks.title: Complete reconciliation and mapping admin center
tasks.objective: Give administrators a compact center for differences, mappings, sync jobs, drift and replay while keeping ordinary users unaware.

tasks.title: Complete finance fusion i18n and responsive UX
tasks.objective: Finish Chinese, English and Lao labels and desktop/mobile states for finance and admin views.

tasks.title: Finance fusion A2/A1/UAT exit Gate
tasks.objective: Coordinate security review, role/DataScope matrix, typecheck, browser smoke and source-value reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Card and report values reconcile by identical dimensions

tasks.title: Harden token lifecycle and credential separation
tasks.objective: Verify proactive refresh, expiry alarms, secret rotation, readonly/write credential separation and redaction.
acceptance_criteria: Token expiry is detectable before failure
Write credential is unavailable to readonly jobs

tasks.title: Harden scheduler, locks, retry and rate limiting
tasks.objective: Use one bounded execution policy for advisory locks, concurrency, exponential backoff, 429 retry and dead-letter HOLD.

tasks.title: Complete alerts, freshness SLO and operator dashboard
tasks.objective: Publish freshness, failure, drift, mapping and reconciliation alerts with runbook links and alert-to-human evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Alert has owner, evidence and action

tasks.title: Implement idempotent replay and stale backlog recovery
tasks.objective: Allow scoped replay by book/scope/period without duplicate snapshots, starvation or audit storms.

tasks.title: Run induced-failure and 24-hour readonly soak
tasks.objective: Verify expiry, 429, 5xx, malformed envelope, timeout, lock contention and recovery over a continuous soak.
acceptance_criteria: All induced failures recover or emit actionable HOLD

tasks.title: Finalize internal voucher candidate lifecycle
tasks.objective: Implement internal draft, validate, review, approve, push-ready, sending, acknowledged, failed, retryable, reversed and cancelled states.

tasks.title: Complete voucher validation and mapping preflight
tasks.objective: Validate balanced entries, period, currency, subject, auxiliary dimensions, counterparty and duplicate source identity.
acceptance_criteria: Unbalanced or incomplete candidate is HOLD

tasks.title: Build durable outbox, receipt and dead-letter contracts
tasks.objective: Persist idempotency key, request hash, provider receipt, retry decision, final disposition and compensating reference without enabling transport.
acceptance_criteria: Timeout and duplicate outcomes are deterministic
Dead-letter item is replayable only by approval

tasks.title: Implement dual-control review and immutable audit UI
tasks.objective: Provide admin/finance reviewer views for draft differences, approval evidence, receipts and retry decisions without an active send button.
acceptance_criteria: Audit trail is readable and immutable

tasks.title: Run provider-stub writeback simulator
tasks.objective: Test success, duplicate, timeout, provider rejection, retry and reversal against a local stub only.

tasks.title: Produce external minimal-write approval package
tasks.objective: Specify one environment, book, document, amount, reviewer, window, idempotency key, readback and reversal procedure for user approval.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback owner and stop rules are explicit

tasks.title: User approval for one external minimal-write canary
tasks.objective: Obtain explicit approval for the exact canary package; no action occurs in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Approval names environment, book, document, amount and rollback

tasks.title: Execute and compensate one approved Chanjet canary
tasks.objective: Send one approved item, read it back, repeat the idempotency key and execute the approved reversal/compensation.
allowed_paths: approved Chanjet endpoint and exact approved ERP integration records
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate has no second financial effect
Residue is zero or explicitly approved

tasks.title: Post-canary A2/A1/A7 Gate
tasks.objective: Aggregate security, runtime, accounting-effect and rollback evidence into GO/HOLD/ROLLBACK.

tasks.title: Freeze controlled-pilot scope and rollback toggles
tasks.objective: Limit approved books, companies, roles, document types, amount thresholds and daily volume.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot scope is named and bounded

tasks.title: Prepare staging deploy and rollback runbook
tasks.objective: Define environment, credentials, migration order, health checks, rollback and evidence collection.

tasks.title: Execute approved controlled pilot
tasks.objective: Run only the approved staging/pilot scope with per-item approval, receipts and daily reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Every write has receipt and audit
Daily difference has zero unexplained P0 item

tasks.title: Controlled-pilot business UAT and final Gate
tasks.objective: Verify create, approve, send, receipt, duplicate rejection, provider rejection, reversal, permissions and reconciliation.

tasks.title: Production rollout approval package
tasks.objective: Prepare phased rollout, rollback, observability, support and 7/14/30-day reconciliation thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Every rollout phase has stop criteria

tasks.title: Execute approved phased production rollout
tasks.objective: Execute only the separately approved rollout phase and stop on any threshold breach.

tasks.title: Thirty-day stabilization and program closeout
tasks.objective: Close the program after 7/14/30-day reliability, reconciliation, security and support evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Source-of-truth matrix and runbooks are final
